description: Marks a booth the person staffs as stepped away, or back; attendees looking at that booth see the presence change. Needs a personal connector token (a shared token reads but changes nothing), `eventId`, `boothId` and `away`. Only a booth the person owns, administers or staffs at that event can be changed, checked against live records on every call. It works in two steps: a call without `confirm` returns a preview of exactly what will change, plus a `confirmToken`, and changes nothing; a call with confirm true and that token makes the change. The token lasts two minutes, works once, and stops working if any argument changes.

away.description: true to mark the booth stepped away, false to mark it back.

boothId.description: The booth id, exactly as events_booths returned it. Not the booth name.

confirm.description: Absent on the first call, which changes nothing. true, together with confirmToken, makes the change.

confirmToken.description: The token the first call returned. Needed when confirm is true.

eventId.description: The event the booth is at, exactly as events_list returned it.

requestId.description: An id for this change chosen by the caller, at least 8 characters. A repeat with the same id and the same arguments returns the first result without changing anything a second time.

name: booth_set_away
title: Mark a booth away
